name: P-H5x160
purpose: Paper 2 (Shen CrossAttn v2): strict 0-shot closed-set 10-TX identification on unseen receivers; hard low-budget source protocol

dataset.name: Shen et al. TMC2024 receiver-agnostic LoRa corpus (20 SDR receivers, 10 TX, labels 31..40)

blind_note: Used as blind set by paper 1; reused history; NOT opened in this protocol (any filename containing these names is refused by lib/xa/guard.py, including Location_* files of n210_2/n210_3).

packet_selection.rule: rng=np.random.default_rng(20261012); ids=sort(concat([rng.choice(flatnonzero(label==c),200,replace=False) for c in 31..40])) -- identical to gai src/shen_p2a8/g1_data.py build_shen (rl1 g1_cache_v1)
packet_selection.source_train: first 160 selected rows per TX (ascending row index)
packet_selection.eval: all 200 selected rows per TX (2000 packets per RX)

folds_note: Source sets = gai g1 source_receiver_folds = rl1 R01/P2 formal sources (fold0 = rl1 CV0, fold1 = rl1 CV1); dev_val = rl1 outer RX, so rl1 CE/ccalign numbers are same-protocol anchors (different models/recipes).
confirm_note: gai g1 'development_receivers'; never used by rl1. Paper 1 used all 14 dev RX (b200_1 was a paper-1 dev fold). DISCLOSURE: on 2026-10-24 (before this freeze) the review computed signal-level statistics on b200_1 and n210_1 (comb/off-comb band ratio, SNR-field correlation, <=400 packets) and CFO-field summaries on all 14 dev RX; no model was trained or evaluated on them. From now on they are loaded only by stage=confirm jobs.

roles.dev_val: exploration: compare arms, choose candidates; never used for checkpoint/LR schedule inside a fit
roles.confirm: loaded only after the stage's decision file is frozen; never used for any choice in that stage

pairing: arms sharing (fold, seed) share data order and AWGN realisations (data_seed = sha256('P-H5x160|fold|seed'))
checkpoint_rule: per recipe (lib/xa/recipes.py); only source_val packets may influence checkpoint, LR schedule or early stopping

metrics.primary: RX-equal mean packet accuracy over the role's receivers
metrics.statistical_unit: receiver (seeds are training repeats, not receivers; packets are not independent units)

forbidden: using dev_val or confirm RX for checkpoint/early-stop/LR schedule
using confirm RX for any choice within the stage that evaluates them
using CFO/SNR HDF5 fields as model inputs (diagnostics only in this round)
